description: Land Title Settlement Department - An Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1913/21 of 08.05.2015, Rathmalana D/S Division - Cad. Map No. 521003
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific details about parcels of land, cadastral maps, villages, and amendments to rights of way and encumbrances on specific land parcels. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations, title amendments, and property boundary/rights modifications.
